items.title: 6.4.2 Use Cases of Blockchain Technology (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of blockchain use cases (PDF 163-164).

items: Cryptocurrencies: Bitcoin aur Ethereum ki bunyad blockchain hai, jo darmiyani fareeq ke baghair decentralized digital transactions mumkin banata hai.
Supply chain management: maal ki nigrani aur tasdeeq, dhoke aur ghalti se bachao aur asliyat ka saboot.
Healthcare: mareezon ke records mehfooz rakhna ta ke sirf mujaz log dekh sakein.
Voting systems: votes durust aur shaffaf darj aur ginna ta ke intikhabi dhandli kam ho.

blocks.text: Blockchain ko aksar aise digital ledger se tashbeeh di jati hai jise network mein sab dekh aur us par mutafiq ho sakein; safha judne ke baad badla nahi ja sakta (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Distributed ledger ka aham faida kya hai (MCQ 4)? Is ka maqsad kya hai (MCQ 7)?
blocks.explanation: (c) decentralized tasdeeq se behtar shaffafiyat aur hifazat; (b) kai shurakaa ko data mehfooz aur shaffaf tareeqe se share aur jaanchne dena.

items: Istemal: cryptocurrency, supply chains, sehat ke records, voting.
